BH-HF4 — initial common-horizon birth geometry

First AH3: it=9536, t=18.625M. Last selected pre-AH3 frame: it=9504, t=18.5625M.

At 18.625M, AH1 centre is (−0.553927,−0.108207,−0.000000), AH2 is (0.553927,0.108207,−0.000000), and separation is 1.128794M. AH3 centre is (−0.000000,0.000000,0.000000). Its spans are (1.932784,0.893932,0.739868)M, max/min=2.612335.

At 20.5625M, AH3 spans are (1.698554,1.437995,1.083260)M, max/min=1.568002.

AH3 appears between 18.5625 and 18.625M; the first coordinate shape is strongly elongated, then becomes less elongated. Main sizes vary smoothly near the old spin/current transition. These are VTK coordinate-embedding properties, not invariant proper distances or physical areas. The later B1 report refines the centre separation using triangle-area weighting.
